title: podrunner unit driver capability record, version 1
description: The answer of a unit driver to probe. A capability that is not proven is the string unknown, and a consumer treats unknown as absent. enforced: the runtime stops the job at the limit. reported: the driver measures it and slots acts on the measurement.

boundary.description: none: the host itself. redirect: path or syscall redirection that is not a boundary against hostile code. confined: kernel enforced confinement of one unit. guest: a separate kernel. Order: none < redirect < confined < guest.

boundary_proof.description: How the boundary was verified on this host. Never empty. For guest it holds the result of the start-up self-test. A driver-supplied string: the conformance suite scans it for credentials.

principal.description: shared: units and the control plane run as one uid on this host. distinct: each unit has its own uid or its own guest.

credential_store.description: tmpfs: the guest's tmpfs or a mounted tmpfs. private-dir: a mode 0700 directory on an ordinary filesystem, removed by destroy. Residue on disk is a stated limit.

mount_modes.description: The modes the driver enforces for a mount. A driver that cannot enforce ro lists only rw.

rootfs_fresh.description: Whether two units of one image share no filesystem state.

egress_hold.description: none: no hold. advisory: traffic is redirected, and hostile code can bypass it, so fixed denies and allow lists are not enforced. enforced: the unit has no other channel.
